result.instructions: Tools for Merchant360, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show this week's shifts and who is not scheduled yet."; "Add a draft shift for Sam on Saturday from 17:00 to 23:00 with a 30-minute break."; "List the pending time-off requests and approve the one from Alex.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Merchant360 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run merchant360_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run merchant360_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run merchant360_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. merchant360_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: merchant360_check_key
tools.title: Check the API key
tools.description: Show the merchant the API key acts on, the key's name, its scopes and whether it is live or test. Use it first to confirm the connection. Merchant360 API: GET /me.

tools.name: merchant360_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List the staff roster (name, title, sort order, whether the person has a login). This list is read-only and not paginated. Shift workers use the roster key from merchant360_list_shifts. Merchant360 API: GET /staff.

tools.name: merchant360_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List team shifts that start in a window, draft and published, earliest first, with the roster of people who can be scheduled (roster[].key is the worker_key to use when writing a shift). Not paginated. The default window starts at Sunday midnight of the current week (server time zone) and lasts 14 days; the window may be at most 92 days. Merchant360 API: GET /shifts.

from.description: Window start, inclusive, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

to.description: Window end, exclusive; must be after from and at most 92 days after it. Default: from plus 14 days, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

tools.name: merchant360_get_shift
tools.title: Get a shift
tools.description: Get one shift by id: worker, start and end, unpaid break, role, note, and whether it is a draft or published. Merchant360 API: GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_schedule_requests
tools.title: List schedule requests
tools.description: List staff time-off requests and shift trade requests (drop, pickup, handoff), newest first. Filter by status when set. Not paginated. Old requests are left out by the vendor. Merchant360 API: GET /schedule-requests.

status.description: Only requests in this status. accepted applies only to trade requests.

tools.name: merchant360_create_shift
tools.title: Create a draft shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT shift. Staff do not see it and no text is sent until merchant360_publish_shifts publishes its window. Omit worker_key for an open shift. A shift lasts at most 24 hours. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts.

worker_key.description: u:<user_id> or c:<cashier_id> from the roster in merchant360_list_shifts. Omit or null for an open shift.

starts_at.description: Shift start, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

ends_at.description: Shift end, after starts_at, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

role.description: Role or station, for example Server. Cut to 40 characters.

note.description: Note the worker sees with the shift.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. Reuse the same key only when retrying the same call after a timeout.

tools.name: merchant360_update_shift
tools.title: Update a shift
tools.description: WRITE: change one shift. Fields you omit keep their value. Send worker_key null to make the shift open, and role or note null (or empty) to clear them. A published shift shows the change to staff only after merchant360_publish_shifts runs again. Merchant360 API: PATCH /shifts/{id}.

worker_key.description: u:<user_id> or c:<cashier_id>; null makes the shift open.

starts_at.description: New shift start, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

ends_at.description: New shift end, after starts_at, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

role.description: Role or station; null or empty clears it.

note.description: Note for the worker; null or empty clears it.

tools.name: merchant360_delete_shift
tools.title: Delete a shift
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete one shift, draft or published. No text is sent. A deleted published shift leaves the staff schedule at the next publish. Merchant360 API: DELETE /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish every DRAFT shift that starts in the window, so staff can see it. Each worker with a published shift and a mobile number gets a text with a link to their schedule. Publishing an already-published window publishes nothing new. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts/publish.

from.description: Window start, inclusive, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

to.description: Window end, exclusive; must be after from, ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-11-23T09:00:00-05:00).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. Reuse the same key only when retrying the same call after a timeout.

tools.name: merchant360_decide_schedule_request
tools.title: Approve or deny a schedule request
tools.description: WRITE: approve or deny one staff time-off or shift trade request. The worker is texted the outcome, with the note when given. Approved time off also blocks those days on the public booking calendar. A decided request returns 409. Merchant360 API: POST /schedule-requests/{id}.

note.description: Optional note for the worker's text (first 100 characters are sent).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. Reuse the same key only when retrying the same call after a timeout.

annotations.title: Approve or deny a schedule request
